title: Conditional κ = 7.08582410781108e-4: completed width-120 entrance banks on #234's five-stage bit supplier
body:
Conditional κ = `177145602695277/250000000000000000` = **0.000708582410781108**, **+0.694%** over #234 (0.000703701743496697) and +1.99% over #230. Full local run passed (`--full` re-runs #234's own six-stage verifier first).

## Idea

#234's five-stage bit supplier completes each of its 2,279 genuine independent entrances with a bundled **rank-5a exterior child** (2,200 of rank 100, plus 18 of rank 60, 48 of rank 65 and 13 of rank 90). Its ledger notes these are "not banked".

This package applies PR197/#205's **completed-bank** construction to the five-stage cover at width **m = 120**: route each entrance residual `I − P_σ` through an exact chart into full-width banks whose disjoint residual involutions multiply to the full endpoint, and drop those exterior children.

- **Charts:** 231 distinct entrance frames (220 PR200 rank-20 + 11 PR210 joint frames), G-orthogonal complement `15a−(Σa)1` for `G=9I−J` plus exact kernel basis; fraction-free inverse and factor replay (≤221 factors, all integers < 2^80).
- **Banks:** 12 data copies → 60 residual occurrences per chain (5 stages × 12 copies). Residual ranks 4/12/11/6 and 24 fill exactly **177,179 banks of width 120** (360×(8·11+8·4), 108×(10·12), 39×(20·6), 4,304×(30·4), 172,368×(5·24)).
- **Colouring:** proper 60-edge-colouring of the 998,580-incidence chain/bank multigraph (colour = stage + 5·copy), checked at both ends; a duplicated colour is rejected.
- **Profile:** W = 12·4v + 177,179 = 261,659, m = 120, deficit 52,800 = 12·4,400 (unchanged per copy), largest child 50. Only the 2,279 exteriors are removed.
- **Arithmetic:** #234's own interval moment engine (with the 10⁻¹⁶ bad-class envelope), three finite ordinary levels and #234's unchanged outer-47 assembly (η=10⁻¹², β=10⁻⁹). Coarse bit saving **7.090849e-4** (was 7.041973e-4); 47 strict inequalities and 7 margins pass; the next 10⁻¹⁸ grid point is rejected. The bit side still binds (complex 7.4745e-4).

| | bit coarse | κ |
|---|---:|---:|
| #234 | 7.041973e-4 | 0.000703701743496697 |
| **this** | **7.090849e-4** | **0.000708582410781108** |

## Reproduce

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds pull/234/head
git worktree add --detach ../pr234 af3fe331ca60c936229e060681ffccbc1c208678
python3 -m pip install sympy==1.14.0
python3 -B research/five-stage-banks/verify.py --pr234-root ../pr234 --full
```
About 4 minutes (3.5 of them are #234's own verifier). A workflow is included.

## Scope

Conditional finite composition. All #234 dependencies are retained (five-stage physical/scalar/prime checks, complex symbolic theorems, weighted q-local compiler, complete-stream movement, copied-centre/restored-row, ordinary leaves, prime supply, precision, all-size reduction). The bank endpoint argument is PR197's, applied with five stage windows; the extra routing bill 12,227,329,044 < 2^40 is absorbed by the inherited ordinary toll as in PR197. Source-owned PR210 gauges are not banked.
